critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 915 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, jobs, estimates, admin, payments) for maintainability.
Dashboard uses _count helper repeatedly (10+ calls per request) - each is a separate MongoDB count query. Consider a single aggregation pipeline for stats to reduce round-trips at scale.
Estimates.js line-item _key generation uses a module-level `lineSeq` counter (line 8) - works but not SSR/hot-reload safe. crypto.randomUUID() would be more robust.
